    Laboratory AS T1
WHERE 
    T1.`Date` BETWEEN '1981-12-01' AND '1982-12-31'
    AND T1.`Birthday` = '1959-02-18'
    AND T1.`T-CHO` > 0;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T-CHO ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T-CHO ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T-CHO ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(`T-CHO` - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` END), 0)) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` END)) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
    AND L.`Date` BETWEEN '1981-12-31' AND '1981-11-30';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Birthday = '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Birthday = '1959-02-18' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    Laboratory AS T2
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS T1
ON 
    T2.ID = T1.ID;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN Date = '1981-12-31' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981' 
            THEN T-CHO 
            ELSE NULL 
        END) - 
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN Date = '1982-12-31' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1982' 
            THEN T-CHO 
            ELSE NULL 
        END) AS cholesterol_decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
INNER JOIN 
    Patient 
ON 
    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    Laboratory
INNER JOIN 
    Patient 
ON 
    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Laboratory.`Date` LIKE '1981-11-%' 
    AND Laboratory.`Date` LIKE '1981-12-%'
    AND Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM((Date LIKE '1981-12-%') THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) - 
         SUM((Date LIKE '1981-11-%') THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    SUM((Date LIKE '1981-11-%') THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS P 
ON 
    L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    L.`Date` BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN Laboratory.T-CHO END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory.T-CHO END)) 
FROM 
    Laboratory 
JOIN 
    Patient 
ON 
    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE 
    Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN L.`T-CHO` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN L.`T-CHO` < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.`T-CHO` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DecreaseInTotalCholesterol
FROM 
    Patient P
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory L 
ON 
    P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l."Date" BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN l."Date" BETWEEN '1981-12-01' AND '1981-12-31' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END)) AS Decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p
ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE p."Birthday" = '1959-02-18';

    ( 
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-%' THEN L.T-CHO ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 
    /
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1980-%' THEN L.T-CHO ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 
    ) AS Decrease_Rate
FROM 
    Patient AS P
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory AS L
ON 
    P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`
        ELSE 0
    END) 
    - SUM(CASE 
        WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`
        ELSE 0
    END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE 
        WHEN Date LIKE '1981-%' THEN `T-CHO`
        ELSE 0
    END)
) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
INNER JOIN 
    Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-01-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-02-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    Date LIKE '1959-02-18' 
    AND (Date LIKE '1981-01-%' OR Date LIKE '1981-02-%');

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) * 100
FROM 
    Laboratory
INNER JOIN 
    Patient 
ON 
    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Laboratory.`Date` IN ('1981-11-01', '1981-12-31')
AND 
    Laboratory.`Date` LIKE '1959-02-18';

    (L.T-CHO - MAX(L.T-CHO)) / MAX(L.T-CHO) AS decreasing_rate

    Patient AS P

    L.ID = P.ID

    CAST(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /

        WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS DecreaseRate

  AND Birthday = '1959-02-18';

    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.`T-CHO` > 0 AND l.`Date` BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1983-12-31' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN l.`T-CHO` > 0 AND l.`Date` BETWEEN '1982-01-01' AND '1983-12-31' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Patient p
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE 
    p.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '1981-12' THEN T-CHO 
            ELSE 0 
        END) -

            WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '1981-10' THEN T-CHO

question: What percentage of male patients who first presented to the hospital in 1981 were diagnosed with BEHCET?
evidence: male refers to SEX = 'M'; first presented to the hospital in 1981 refers to YEAR(`FIRST DATE`) = '1981'; BEHCET refers to diagnosis; calculation = DIVIDE(SUM(DIAGNOSIS = 'BEHCET') where YEAR(`FIRST DATE`) = '1981', MULTIPLY(COUNT(YEAR(`FIRST DATE`) = '1981')), 100)

    COUNT(P.ID)

question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to `T-CHO` > = 250;
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', date('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

pool.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 100.0
FROM 
    Laboratory l
INNER JOIN 
    Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE 
    p.SEX = 'M' 
    AND l.T-CHO >= 250;

FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND e.T-CHO >= 250;

FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE T-CHO >= 250 AND Patient.sex = 'M';

    AVG(CAST((CAST(MIN(birthday) AS INTEGER) - (SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') FROM Laboratory)) AS REAL)) AS average_age
FROM 
    Laboratory
JOIN 
    Patient 
ON 
    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    T-CHO >= 250 AND 
    Patient.SEX = 'M';

    (SUM((julianday('now') - julianday(birthday)) / 365)) / COUNT(*) AS average_age
FROM 
    Patient
WHERE 
    sex = 'M' 
    AND T-CHO >= 250;

    (SUM(COUNT(YEAR(T2.`birthday`))) - COUNT(P.ID)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS average_age
FROM 
    Patient AS P
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T2
ON 
    P.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
    P.SEX = 'M' 
    AND T2.T-CHO >= 250;

  AND L.T-CHO >= 250;

question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to PLT <= 100 or PLT >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to PLT < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(PLT < 100), SUM(PLT > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to PLT > 400;
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

pool.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 END) - 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 END) AS abnormal_range_difference
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT IN (100, 400);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PltLT100,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PltGT400
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN L.PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) - 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN L.PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS abnormal_diff
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
JOIN 
    Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_normal_range_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_normal_range_count
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) - 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN ID END) AS number_of_patients_with_abnormal_plates
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM 
    Laboratory

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) AS abnormal_platelet_count, 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
     (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.PLT <= 100 OR T1.PLT >= 400)) AS lower_than_normal_ratio
FROM 
    Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS low_abnormal_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS high_abnormal_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS abnormal_to_normal_ratio
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM
    Laboratory;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PT.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PT.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_and_high_normal_count
FROM Laboratory AS PT;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN LATPLT < 100 THEN 1 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN LATPLT > 400 THEN 1 END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM 
    Laboratory AS LAT
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS PAT 
ON 
    LAT.ID = PAT.ID
WHERE 
    LATPLT IN (100, 400);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal_range,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal_range
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_count
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 END) AS lower_than_normal_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 END) AS higher_than_normal_count
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
WHERE 
    PLT IN (SELECT PLT FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_range_count
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
JOIN 
    Patient AS P
ON 
    L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    L.PLT IN (100, 400);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_range_count
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS P
ON 
    L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    L.PLT IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_plt_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_plt_count
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
JOIN 
    Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
GROUP BY 
    L.PLT
HAVING 
    abnormal_plt_count < high_plt_count;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_plt_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_plt_count
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_range_count
FROM 
    Laboratory;

    AVG(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LessThan100Patients, 
    AVG(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GreaterThan400Patients
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT SIGN(SUM(PLT < 100)) - SIGN(SUM(PLT > 400)) AS abnormal_badness
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS abnormal_patitals_below_threshold,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS abnormal_patitals_above_threshold
FROM 
    Laboratory;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT <= 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_100_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT >= 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_400_count
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.PLT < 100 THEN 1 END) AS lower_normal_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 400 THEN 1 END) AS higher_normal_count
FROM 
    Laboratory l
JOIN 
    Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE 
    l.PLT IN (100, 400)
ORDER BY 
    (LOWER_normal_count / higher_normal_count);

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS abnormal_platelet_diff
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal_count
FROM 
    Laboratory
WHERE 
    PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS LowerNormalCount,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS HigherNormalCount
FROM Laboratory

    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE PLT <= 100) - 
    (SELECT COUNT(*)

     WHERE PLT >= 400) AS abnormal_platelet_level_diff;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 END) AS low_normal_count,

    Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID

    Laboratory.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

question: What is the percentage of patient who has a abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase level, yet he or she is diagnosed with SLE?
evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to GOT > = 60; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60 AND Diagnosis = 'SLE'), COUNT(ID WHERE GOT > = 60)), 1.0);
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN T1.ID ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`GOT` >= 60

pool.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(P.ID) AS percentage
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS P
ON 
    L.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN GOT >= 60 THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS abnormal_level_percentage
FROM 
    Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS T2 
ON 
    T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
    T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT 
    (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN L.ID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) 
     * 100.0) / COUNT(P.ID) AS abnormal_sle_percentage
FROM 
    Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN 
    Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
INNER JOIN 
    Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE 
    P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(L.GOT)) AS abnormal_sle_percentage

    L.ID = P.ID

question: How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?

WHERE 
    b.category = 'Advertisement'

    b.category
HAVING 
    ratio > 1;

       SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN amount ELSE 0 END);

question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.

question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
evidence: February 2012 refers to '201202' in yearmonth.date; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Consumption > 528.3, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'

pool.sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS Percentage
FROM 
    yearmonth
WHERE 
    Date = '201202';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Amount > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T1.date = T2.Date
WHERE 
    T1.date LIKE '201202%';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Amount > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS Percentage
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T1.Date LIKE '201202%' 
ORDER BY 
    T1.Date DESC;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS ConsumptionAboveThreshold
FROM 
    yearmonth
WHERE 
    Date = '201202';

SELECT 
    yearmonth.Year, 
    yearmonth.Month, 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN yearmonth.Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS Percentage
FROM 
    yearmonth
WHERE 
    yearmonth.Date = '201202'
GROUP BY 
    yearmonth.Year, 
    yearmonth.Month;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Amount > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.TransactionID) AS percentage
FROM 
    yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    transactions_1k AS T2
ON 
    T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID AND T1.Date = T2.Date
WHERE

question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)
gold_sql: SELECT T2.CustomerID, SUM(T2.Price / T2.Amount), T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.CustomerID = ( SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth ORDER BY Consumption DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T2.CustomerID, T1.Currency

pool.sql:
SELECT 
    customers.Currency, 
    SUM(transactions_1k.price) / SUM(transactions_1k.amount) AS AvgPricePerItem
FROM 
    transactions_1k
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
INNER JOIN 
    customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    customers.CustomerID, customers.Currency
ORDER BY 
    AvgPricePerItem DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    characters.CustomerID,
    (SUM(transactions_1k.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(transactions_1k.Amount)) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    characters.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k
INNER JOIN 
    customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    characters.CustomerID, characters.Currency
ORDER BY 
    AveragePricePerItem DESC
LIMIT 1;
